sources.text: MIDLAB Home Who We Are Research Participate in a Study Oxford Submissions Prospective Students Publications Contact Home Who We Are Research Participate in a Study Oxford Submissions Prospective Students Publications Contact Search MiD lab M ental Health in Design Lab There is no health without mental health. [WHO] Thus, there is no healthy technology interaction without considering mental health, including psychological and emotional well-being. If we want to improve the lives and health of people, we need to consider mental health at the forefront of all technology design and interaction. Artificial Intelligence & GenAI Algorithms​ Mobile Apps & Devices Social Media ​ Online Communities Understanding psychological, emotional, & social needs ​= Better, safer, more effective technology Technology is pervasive. Mental health matters. 77% of US smartphone owners have looked up health information online [Pew Research, 2013] 72% of people in the US use social media ​ [Statista, 2018] 58% of people in the US have downloaded a health app ​ [Krebs & Duncan, 2015] Mental health impacts ALL aspects of our lives . More than 50% of people in the US will be diagnosed with a mental illness at some point in their lifetime [CDC] 45,700,000 of US adults in a given year experience mental illness [NIMH, 2016] Yet treatment rates are low .
